answer: Citation bond: an agent posts 70 credits for one lotus citation of real work. Each citation crosses a bridge check: its author confirms it, or an auditor replays it. A jade seal marks verified citations publicly; loops burn both bonds. Fees rise: the k-th fake pays 40+7(k-1); a thousand fakes pay 3,536,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented citations fail: a bought one bears the lender's seal. An honest agent pays 40 once.
